key_insight: SOLID lets an OR language model learn from its own solver-generated artifacts, removing the need for verified answers or an external evaluator while improving training signal density.
engineering_relevance: This provides a scalable way to bootstrap reliable natural-language-to-optimization modeling systems for operations research workflows.
method: Sample multiple candidate OR programs from the model’s own rollouts.
Run the solver, cluster outcomes/objectives, and pick a majority-group artifact as a pseudo-reference.
Update the model with group-relative advantages plus dense self-supervision from the selected artifact.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved solution accuracy across multiple OR benchmarks for both general-purpose and OR-tuned models compared with outcome-only group-relative training.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of solver artifacts and clustering, so noisy rollouts or unstable objective grouping could reduce training reliability.
paper_title: Beyond Verified Answers: Solver-Informed Self-Distillation for Bootstrapping Operations Research Language Models
